name: Kwa'
world_status: accessible description is silent on stress

earlier_scan.verdict: a source was named but could not be reached
earlier_scan.source_named: Talla Sandeu, Cyrille (2020) De la standardisation du Kwáʔ: D'une esquisse morphologique à l'orthographe, MA thesis (181 pp.); also Tientcheu Tchameni (2008) phonology. Neither found online.

sources.citation: Talla Sandeu, Cyrille. 2020. De la standardisation du kwáʔ : D'une esquisse morphologique à l'orthographe. Mémoire de Master, Université de Yaoundé I. 182 pp. HAL: dumas-04283636.
sources.access_detail: a digital copy (available on request); access check: open copy online
sources.note: Silent on word stress. Ch. 1 'Rappel phonologique' (pp. 11-46) and ch. 2 nominal tonology (pp. 55-58) describe a purely tonal prosody: 5 tonemes (H, M, L, rising LH, falling HL), syllabic nasals carry level tones only (p. 29); tone-pattern lists per stem shape (pp. 56-58); orthography keeps 4 of 5 tonemes (p. 127) and marks H with acute, L with grave (p. 129). The word 'accent' occurs only for tone diacritics (p. 129) and a speaker's regional accent (p. 108); no mention of intensity, prominence, length-based stress or intonation.

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.3 languoid page and JSON for kwaa1265 (Nsiteu-Kwa'), and Wikipedia 'Kwaʼ language' (wikitext, cites Talla Sandeu 2020 with the DUMAS URL and Tientcheu Tchameni 2008)
sources.note: Glottolog lists only three sources (Talla Sandeu 2020, Tientcheu Tchameni 2008, Elias et al. 1984). Wikipedia's phonology section, built from Talla Sandeu 2020, reports 3 level + 2 contour tones and nothing on stress; it supplied the DUMAS link that led to the open PDF.

sources.citation: Tientcheu Tchameni, N. N. 2008. Esquisse phonologique du Kwáʔ (code ALCAM 990) et proposition d'une orthographe. Mémoire de Maîtrise, Université de Dschang.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.access_detail: a digital copy exists, not open: the recorded link leads to a login, a search-only view or a restricted repository; the linked copy is not accessible
sources.note: The only dedicated phonology of Kwa' and the base for the 2020 thesis; a full structural phonology (phonemes, tonemes, syllable) is the one place a remark on accent/stress or its absence could exist. Glottolog's hh record exists but has no file; a print copy sits at Université de Dschang (and per Talla Sandeu 2020 p. 8 in the ANACLAC/CERDOTOLA/SIL Yaoundé libraries).

sources.citation: Brye, Edward & Domche Teko, Engelbert. 2000. Première évaluation globale de la situation sociolinguistique chez les kwa' (ALCAM 990). Yaoundé: SIL.
sources.tag: likely states stress; not yet obtained
sources.note: SIL rapid-appraisal survey; would settle the Kwa'/Nsiteu naming and dialect identity, may carry a short wordlist, but a stress statement is unlikely.
